name: Desktop Essentials
description: A starting layout for desktop navigation: left stick moves the pointer, right stick scrolls vertically and horizontally, D-pad provides arrow keys, face buttons provide clicks and shortcuts, and shoulders also scroll. See the assignments below for your controller's button names.

name: Browser Essentials
description: A starting browser layout: left stick moves the pointer, right stick scrolls vertically and horizontally, face buttons provide clicks, the address bar and find, shoulders also scroll, and the D-pad provides history and tab navigation. See the assignments below for your controller's button names. Works at the browser application level.

name: Star Trek Online - PS5-style (PC)
description: DualSense starting template for default PC keyboard bindings. Layout 1 Space, 2 Ground, 3 Menus. This is console-inspired, not the console UI: no ability wheels or conditional power automation. Ground: Cross jumps; Circle and D-pad Up interact; R3 is unassigned. Left stick moves; right stick moves the mouse pointer. Hold L2 for ground camera drag, R3 for space camera drag, while moving the right stick. Ability buttons use numbered PC tray slots: arrange your powers to match the labels. Add an Applications rule for GameClient.exe and reserve Create (SDL button 4) to cycle these layouts; the template leaves Create unassigned. PC camera, pitch and keybind settings can differ. No game/hardware testing performed.

name: Star Trek Online - Xbox-style (PC)
description: Xbox starting template for default PC keyboard bindings: Space, Ground and Menus. Console-inspired PC mapping; no console ability wheels or conditional automation. A jumps on Ground; D-pad Up interacts. Hold LT for ground camera drag or right stick click in Space. Powers use numbered tray slots; arrange them to match the labels. Reserve View / Back (SDL button 4) in an Applications rule for GameClient.exe to cycle layouts. Standard Xbox controls work without Elite paddles. Hardware and gameplay are untested.

name: Star Trek Online - Steam Controller (2015)
description: Physical Valve Steam Controller (2015) starting template for default PC bindings: Space, Ground and Menus. Reserve Back / Menu (SDL button 4) to cycle layouts through a GameClient.exe Applications rule. Right touchpad moves the pointer; press it to drag the camera in Space/Ground or select in Menus. Grips offer camera drag and sprint/fire shortcuts. Numbered tray powers need arrangement in STO. Console radial menus and automation are not reproduced. Use Bifrost 0.1.5 or newer with its SDL3 runtime; avoid a simultaneous Steam keyboard/mouse layout. Hardware and gameplay are untested.

name: Minecraft Java - PS5-style (PC)
description: Java Edition only. Bedrock already offers native controller support. Uses PC movement, mouse look, attack/use, hotbar scrolling and inventory shortcuts. In the inventory layout, the right stick moves the cursor; inventory navigation remains the Java mouse interface. Console-inspired starting template, not exact console parity. Keyboard movement is digital; right stick provides mouse look/pointer. Disable competing keyboard/mouse mappings and use PC keyboard/mouse input for this alternative. Layouts switch manually: create an App rule for the actual game executable, select only these named sets and reserve Create / View / Back (SDL index 4). This button is unassigned in all layouts. No automatic in-game state detection. Hardware/gameplay untested.
